description: Today's GPU rental prices: the price index in USD per GPU-hour for each GPU (H100, H200, A100, B200, B300, RTX PRO 6000, L40S, RTX A6000, RTX 6000 Ada, L40, RTX 5090, RTX 4090), with 1-day, 1-week and 1-month changes, its price trend over 13 weeks (direction, strength, score, speed per month) and its rank by the trend's strength, the order of the home page's list and of this one (sort and order give another: the cheapest first, the largest 1-month change first), the index day and a link to each GPU's page. Give one GPU to also get what its page shows: its benchmark contract, each provider's average price standardized to that contract, the posted prices of providers outside the index (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Oracle, Koyeb, Packet: each one's lowest, as posted) and its compute futures prices: each exchange listing a contract on its rental price, with the last price and 24-hour volume, refreshed every minute (all of them: https://computescreener.com/futures). For past values use get_price_history; for providers' posted prices get_provider_prices. For questions like "what does an H100 cost per hour?", "how much is it to rent a B200?", "H200 cloud pricing today" or "which GPU's price is trending up the most?".

gpu.description: One GPU; omit for all listed GPUs.

order.description: With sort: "asc" for the smallest first (name: A to Z; rank: 1 up), "desc" for the largest first. Without it: rank and name ascending, the others largest first, as the page's headers start.

sort.description: The order of the list's rows, as pressing a column header on the home page orders them: rank (the page's own order, its #, by trend strength), name (A to Z), or price, change_1d, change_1w, change_1m or trend (the signed trend score), each largest first. E.g. sort "price", order "asc": the cheapest GPU first; sort "change_1m": the largest 1-month rise first. A row without the value comes last.

name: get_gpu_prices

age_minutes.description: Minutes from updated to this answer (the site's header shows the time, and how long ago once prices are delayed): the values are recalculated every minute while the live collector runs, several times a day otherwise (get_data_status: live)

change_1d_pct.description: Percent change from the latest value 1 to 4 days earlier (none: interpolated)

change_1m_pct.description: Percent change from the latest value 30 to 37 days earlier (none: interpolated)

change_1w_pct.description: Percent change from the latest value 7 to 10 days earlier (none: interpolated)

errata.description: Errors found in its final values: for one GPU or company, the last year's, as its page notes them under its value; in the list, those in the values its row gives (its latest, and the bases of its changes, which are changes of the values as published). As the page notes them under its value and the status page lists them: each a run of index days. A final value is never changed; the correct one is given when it can be recomputed, and the error is fixed from the next day

correct.description: The correct index value (none when it cannot be recomputed)

published.description: The index value as published those days (none when it differs from day to day)

reason.description: Why it was wrong, as the status page says

note.description: A contract not trading yet: its status, as the futures page shows it

price.description: The exchange's last price; none once its exchange has not refreshed it for 12 hours, as on the site

other_posted_prices.description: Providers outside the index (the hyperscalers): each one's lowest on-demand price per GPU-hour as posted, not standardized, and not in the index; a price posted in euros is converted at the ECB rate of the day (posted_eur: the euro price), as the site shows it

posted_eur.description: The price as posted, in euros, when the provider posts in euros (Seeweb)

price.description: Latest index value, USD per GPU-hour

average_price.description: Its average price, standardized to the benchmark contract

carried_from.description: Not priced today: the day of its last reading

read_at.description: When its prices were last read (the page's As of)

provisional.description: True while the day is not over

trend.description: Its price trend over 13 weeks, as the home page's Trend column and # show it

direction.description: The arrow: rising, falling, or flat at a score of 0.0

per_month_pct.description: The trend line's speed per month, percent

rank.description: The home page's #: its place by trend strength among those listed, strongest first, rising or falling

score.description: The slope of a least-squares line through the logarithms of the index on 13 dates a week apart, over its standard error; negative when falling; none with less than 12 weeks of history

strength.description: strong: a score of 4 or more either way; moderate: 2 to 4; weak: under 2

markets_note.description: What the compute futures prices are, with markets

sorted_by.description: The order of the rows, when sort or order asked for another than the home page's own

updated.description: When the GPU prices were last calculated (ISO 8601, UTC)

title: GPU rental prices
